name: ClinuxFlowAffiliateOrganization
title: ClinuxFlow Affiliate Organization
description: An organization-to-organization relationship — a partner org (imaging centre, laboratory, billing service, ...) delivering a shared service to/through this facility. Profiles FHIR R4 OrganizationAffiliation, the resource built specifically for this ('org A provides service X to org B'), not a repurposed Organization or an ad hoc join table. Genuinely new — nothing in this app modeled organization-level affiliation before this spec (only the practitioner-level kind existed, see ClinuxFlowAffiliatePractitionerRole). No ABDM API reference exists for this concept (HFR/HPR have no organization-affiliation notion); cardinalities here are real FHIR R4 base-resource judgment, not a cited external spec.

element.comment: The primary facility this affiliation is anchored to.

The affiliate/partner organization providing the service. No targetProfile constraint to ClinuxFlowFacility: an affiliate org (e.g. an external diagnostic lab chain) has no reason to conform to this app's own Facility profile at all.

The nature of the affiliation (e.g. 'provider', 'diagnostics', 'billing') — bound to real FHIR's own organization-role ValueSet where it fits, extended locally only for genuinely ClinuxFlow-specific relationship kinds (e.g. 'shared-imaging-service') not already covered by it.
If the affiliation is clinical in nature (e.g. a visiting-specialist arrangement fulfilled at the org level rather than one named practitioner), the relevant specialty/specialties.

Which of the primary facility's own HealthcareService entries this affiliate actually fulfills — real FHIR field for exactly SPEC-23's own framing ('administrative steps... some of these may become shared service offered by affiliates'). A HealthcareService with no healthcareService reference here is one the facility fulfills itself, not through an affiliate.
A contact point for THIS AFFILIATION specifically (e.g. a dedicated referral line), distinct from the affiliate organization's own general telecom.
